cola1917/ad-eval-suite#10.technical_summary: Added simulation-validation CI with default XOSC checks, opt-in manual esmini smoke execution, report artifacts, and temporary-file ignore rules.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#11.technical_summary: Unified evaluation, mining, simulation, and visualization entry points under one CLI; reorganized module boundaries, split configurations, and updated imports/tests/documentation.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#4.technical_summary: Added fast/nightly perception CI, deterministic detection/tracking fixtures, golden metrics, and a regression runner.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#5.technical_summary: Added failure-case ranking, serialized scenario snapshots, frame replay, and initial OpenSCENARIO export with unit tests.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#6.technical_summary: Added raw nuScenes map geometry loading, viewport queries, lane/drivable-area overlays, snapshot location metadata, and replay export options.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#7.technical_summary: Extended replay integration with GIF export options, Pillow-based GIF handling, progress reporting, and export tests; the underlying map loader was introduced separately in #6.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#8.technical_summary: Propagated map-location metadata into failure-mining snapshots so replay can select the appropriate map.

cola1917/ad-eval-suite#9.technical_summary: Added OpenSCENARIO XML/semantic and optional XSD validation plus a batch esmini smoke runner with timeout/dry-run reports and unit tests.

colmap/colmap#4892.technical_summary: Exposed five existing Ceres solver-selection image-count thresholds for local and global incremental bundle adjustment through C++ pipeline options, Mapper CLI/project settings, and PyCOLMAP. Preserved defaults and added propagation, round-trip, and reconstruction tests; no GPU performance claim.

colmap/colmap#4903.technical_summary: Added actionable insufficient-driver diagnostics and a common CUDA/HIP error formatter while preserving the zero-device return used by CPU-fallback callers. Added error-code/description tests; does not claim to fix Windows CLI exception termination or verify HIP execution.

eric-heiden/newton#17.technical_summary: Added MJCF camera-import tests comparing inherited/physical/pixel intrinsics and moving-body mount transforms against native MuJoCo. Test-only merge into eric-heiden/newton, a fork; not a merged contribution to newton-physics/newton.

ForgeAI-Robotics/fq-assets#1.technical_summary: Added a simulation-scene asset package with assembly manifests, MuJoCo/USD assets, provenance, previews, validation evidence, and catalog/checksum updates. Public merge verified; asset physics and approval process were not independently rerun.

google-deepmind/mujoco_warp#1853.technical_summary: Kept contact direction attached to contact IDs through mindist/maxforce reduction sorting by complement-encoding negative directions. Removed the separate direction buffer while retaining the single-int GPU sort; regressions compare native MuJoCo across heterogeneous worlds and CPU/CUDA graph replay. Public PR measurements describe removal of a regression, not a general speedup.

newton-physics/newton#4871.technical_summary: Corrected analytic IK forward-kinematics and Jacobian indexing when joint and body indices differ. Follow articulation-tree ancestors, seed external root poses, and reject unsupported objective links or multiply articulated bodies; loop-closure constraints are not enforced.

newton-physics/newton#4874.technical_summary: Gave L-BFGS candidate residuals independent gradient storage so Warp tape.zero() cannot erase line-search costs and accept an increasing step. Added a CPU/CUDA regression through public IKSolver behavior.

newton-physics/newton#4890.technical_summary: Restored runtime shape-color updates in the single-model RTX path through per-instance USD display-color readers. Kept built-instance mappings stable across viewer repacking and used a device-side change flag to avoid full color readback on unchanged frames, without rebuilding geometry.

newton-physics/newton#4894.technical_summary: Restored runtime shape-opacity updates in the single-model RTX viewer using per-instance opacity/IOR primvars and stable instance mappings. Preserved explicit fractional-opacity settings, reused device-side change detection, and added rendered-pixel regressions.

newton-physics/newton#4905.technical_summary: Rejected NaN and infinite contact-material values on colliding shapes during ModelBuilder.finalize(), with array/shape diagnostics. Covered direct, imported USD, and replicated inputs while preserving visual-only exemptions and validation opt-outs; this is not an importer-wide audit.

newton-physics/newton#4942.technical_summary: Prevented silent truncation of high-valence Style3D projective-dynamics matrix connections. Retry overflowed 32-wide assembly with topology-derived capacity and reject incomplete builders; regressions compare entries against dense assembly, symmetry, and translation-nullspace checks.

pypose/pypose#439.technical_summary: Preserved expanded views instead of flattening and copying broadcast Lie-group inputs across SO3, SE3, RxSO3, and Sim3. Made Act outputs contiguous for downstream view compatibility; regressions cover non-contiguous/empty inputs and forward/backward equivalence. PR-reported allocation measurements support input-copy removal, not resolution of the original full bundle-adjustment OOM.

yipingho/FIT5120_TM11#1.technical_summary: Added PostgreSQL catalog models, raw-to-seed ETL, configurable nutrition rules, seed loading, consistency SQL, and anomaly reporting with generated seed/staging artifacts.

zwan0616/FIT5120_TM11#27.technical_summary: Organized CI into white-box, API smoke, and API regression jobs, with coverage/JUnit artifacts and consolidated Markdown reports.

zwan0616/FIT5120_TM11#30.technical_summary: Added a seeded daily-challenge database model, selection/completion API routes, startup initialization, and white-box/integration tests.

zwan0616/FIT5120_TM11#31.technical_summary: Removed the pytest-asyncio dependency from daily-challenge white-box tests using asyncio.run and aligned scan-recognition fixtures with the current contract.

zwan0616/FIT5120_TM11#35.technical_summary: Revised user-facing feedback strings in daily-challenge seed data.

zwan0616/FIT5120_TM11#41.technical_summary: Expanded challenge-status and rule-based backend tests, migrated API smoke checks to pytest, added integration metrics/retry support and mock-AI controls, and revised report/coverage configuration.

zwan0616/FIT5120_TM11#51.technical_summary: Updated pair-programming documentation; this is a documentation contribution rather than an algorithm or simulation change.
